onCampus.title: Chapultepec
onCampus.description: Traditional-style first-year residence hall with triple-occupancy rooms (limited doubles). Co-ed by room with communal restrooms. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. Amenities include 24/7 front desk, AC, meal plan, community kitchen, furnished rooms, and utilities included.

onCampus.title: Huāxyacac
onCampus.description: Traditional-style first-year residence hall with triple-occupancy rooms (limited quads, doubles, and singles). Co-ed by room with communal restrooms. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. Shares a courtyard with Chapultepec featuring an Aztec Market, coffee shop, shuffleboard, basketball court, and BBQs.

onCampus.title: Maya & Olmeca
onCampus.description: Traditional-style first-year residence halls with double/triple-occupancy rooms. Co-ed by room with communal restrooms. Access via stairs only (no elevators). Located near The Garden Restaurant. Shares an outdoor recreation area with Zura and Tenochca featuring a pool, basketball court, volleyball court, putting green, and BBQs.

onCampus.title: South Campus Plaza — North Tower
onCampus.description: Suite-style first-year and sophomore community. Triple and double-occupancy rooms. Co-ed by room with private restroom shared by suitemates. Located near the Aztec Student Union. Ground floor retail includes Trader Joe's, Eureka!, and more.

onCampus.title: South Campus Plaza — South Tower
onCampus.description: Suite-style first-year and sophomore community. Triple and double-occupancy rooms. Co-ed by room with private restroom shared by suitemates. Features outdoor patio with fire pits, lounge seating and BBQs.

onCampus.title: Tenochca
onCampus.description: Traditional-style first-year residence hall with triple-occupancy rooms. Co-ed by room with communal restrooms. Located near The Garden Restaurant. Shares recreation area with Zura and Maya & Olmeca featuring a pool, basketball court, volleyball court, putting green, and BBQs.

onCampus.title: Texcoco
onCampus.description: Brand-new suite-style community for first-year and sophomore students opening Fall 2026. Triple-occupancy suites with private bathrooms. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. Features combined community kitchen and lounge space on each floor.

onCampus.title: University Towers
onCampus.description: Suite-style first-year residence hall with two double-occupancy rooms per suite. Co-ed by suite with private shared restroom. Located next to UTK restaurant. Amenities include on-site fitness, study spaces, and full furnishings.

onCampus.title: Zura
onCampus.description: Traditional-style first-year residence hall with triple-occupancy rooms (limited quads, doubles, and singles). Co-ed by room with communal restrooms. Features an observation deck and shares recreation area with Tenochca and Maya & Olmeca.

onCampus.title: Aztec Corner
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 1-2 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, private bathrooms, in-unit laundry, reserved parking, and balcony/patio on select units. Located near Viejas Arena and the ARC. 9-month or 11.5-month lease options.

onCampus.title: Granada
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 3-4 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, private bathrooms, in-unit washer & dryer, community lounge, reserved parking, and courtyard with seating and BBQs. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Huaxtepec
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 1-2 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, private bathrooms, reserved parking, swimming pool, and furnished units. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: M@College
onCampus.description: SDSU-affiliated apartment-style community for sophomores. 3-bedroom units with double/single occupancy rooms. Features full kitchen, private bathrooms, in-unit washer & dryer, heated spa, fitness facility, swimming pool, and reserved parking. Only 6-minute walk to the Aztec Student Union. 11.5-month lease through summer.

onCampus.title: Metepec
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with studio and 1-bedroom units. Features full kitchen, furnished units, reserved parking, swimming pool, and on-site laundry. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Mixquic
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 2-3 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, furnished units, meal plan, reserved parking, and swimming pool. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Piedra Del Sol
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 2-4 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, private bathrooms, furnished units, courtyard with seating and BBQs, reserved parking, and meal plan. Located near Viejas Arena and ARC. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Sunset Plaza
onCampus.description: Suite-style community for first-year and sophomore students. Double and single-occupancy rooms with private bathrooms. One of the newest SDSU residential communities. Features 24-hour full-service community kitchen, outdoor patio with lounge seating, reserved parking, and furnished units. 9-month lease option.

onCampus.title: Tepeyac & Tacuba
onCampus.description: Suite-style sophomore community with 6-7 bedroom units featuring triple, double, and single-occupancy rooms. Each unit has a kitchenette and living area. Private bathrooms, furnished, meal plan, swimming pool, volleyball court, and study spaces. Located next to The Garden Restaurant. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Tacuba
onCampus.description: Suite-style sophomore community with 6-7 bedroom units featuring triple, double, and single-occupancy rooms. Each unit has a kitchenette and living area. Private bathrooms, furnished, meal plan, swimming pool, volleyball court, and study spaces. Located next to The Garden Restaurant. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Toltec
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 1-2 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, furnished units, reserved parking, swimming pool, and on-site laundry. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Villa Alvarado
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 2-3 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, private bathrooms, furnished units, community recreation room with piano and pool table, reserved parking, and meal plan. Located near the I-8 freeway. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Viva
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 2-4 bedroom units. Features 24-hour emergency maintenance, community lounge, fire pit, full kitchen, furnished units, in-unit washer & dryer, reserved parking, and meal plan. One of the newest additions to SDSU housing. 11.5-month lease option.

onCampus.title: Zacatepec
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 1-3 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, furnished units, reserved parking, swimming pool, and on-site laundry. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. 9-month lease.

onCampus.title: Zapotec
onCampus.description: Apartment-style sophomore community with 1-3 bedroom units. Features full kitchen, furnished units, reserved parking, swimming pool, and on-site laundry. Located near Tony Gwynn Stadium. 9-month lease.
